findings.issue: Piel participle suffix is 2nd masculine plural. su, with él/lo as the only antecedent, is a third-person possessive, so the one sanctified shifts from you-plural to the priest.
Suffix is 2nd feminine singular; a ti does not mark feminine.
Hiphil participle is causative (bring near). acercante can be heard as intransitive approach.

notes: Weqatal 2ms + 3ms, both קדש adjectives, Jehová, and Dios match the tokens.
